messages.text: I am the Pearl Dealer, and you are on dangerous ground.
messages.zh: 我是珍珠商人,你脚下这片土地可不太平。

messages.zh: 在这座岛上使用末影珍珠时要小心,它的能量会招来末影人!

messages.text: The End also has many resources, including End Stone and Obsidian.
